UnbreakableDuty.description: <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Ancient Thoread</style> and all friendly units within {[range]} hexes receive <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> until the start of their next turn. If 2 or more friendly <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style> <style="Character">Characters</style> are dead upon activation of this ability, <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Ancient Thoread</style> gains <style="Stat_Health">{[extraHp]} extra Health</style> and <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> until the end of the battle and immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against an adjacent enemy.
